name: Gas-fired condensing hot-water boiler
description: Packaged hydronic boiler that cools flue gas below its dew point to recover the latent heat of water vapour, using corrosion-resistant duplex or stainless heat-transfer surfaces. Available as one-pass firetube designs with premix or dual-fuel burners, with high turndown and integrated controls for commercial and institutional heating.

specifications.metric: minimum combustion efficiency, large commercial gas hot-water boiler
specifications.basis: DOE FEMP purchasing requirement for 2.5-10 MMBtu/hr input gas-fired hot-water boilers, based on 10 CFR 431.86
AHRI thermal 96.0% and combustion 94.7%; the page's 'up to 99%' is marketing wording
10:1 fully modulating on the ClearFire-CE product page
Under 20 ppm NOx standard, sub-7 ppm optional (OEM specification)
Manufacturer states burner and controls support up to 20% volumetric hydrogen-natural gas blend; not a certification
AHRI combustion 95.6% / thermal 96.3%; 'up to 98%' is OEM wording
